review_scope: One proposed matched gradient-teacher pair only; fixedtrain diagnostic JSON and immutable existing source were read. No new experiments, cache generation, label scan or implementation changes.

evidence.diagnostic_scope: Only this training CAD's known ver/hor/tor; recovered reference P1 from training displacement, not a solver strain tensor or source signed-stress definition.
evidence.precision_or_cause_inference: These values motivate a gradient-quality optimization test. One CAD and a recovered-node diagnostic do not prove the cause, quantify cell-loss magnitude on all120 train cases, or establish a signed-stress constitutive target.

reviewed_pair_contract.model: Same load-linear PhysicsField, original25+local13, global32, decoder width128/two hidden layers, seed2026 in both new branches; original implementations remain immutable.
reviewed_pair_contract.budget: 10k updates, batch51200/four equally sampled cases; per case6400 uniformly sampled original nodes plus1600 uniformly sampled tetrahedra x4corners =12800 model queries. Same common samples and initialization in both branches.
reviewed_pair_contract.loss: Both use the same relative-case u loss on all12800 queries; only lambda0 versus1 of the volume-weighted physical P1 symmetric-Frobenius error differs.
reviewed_pair_contract.normalizers: Common zero-center train-only u scaler; per-training-case full-volume true P1 Frobenius RMS squared from original training u only. No validation/dia/final-test strain normalization.
reviewed_pair_contract.selection: Same known-load validation15 case-mean all-original-node physical u relative L2 only, not strain/dia. Report strain quality at that u-selected checkpoint and final checkpoint without selecting by strain.
reviewed_pair_contract.reference_boundary: P1 from source training u is an auxiliary optimization reference under the same discrete operator, not source solver GT tensor, a new physics law or an identified scalar-stress formula.

exact_math.corner_order: Use the verified original TETRA10 first4 corner IDs. Midpoint order does not enter the corner solve, but all10 IDs enter the historical nodal recovery.
exact_math.edge_matrix: D[t,a,j]=x_mm[t,a+1,j]-x_mm[t,0,j], a,j=0..2, stored in float64. Rows index corner edges and columns physical coordinate directions.
exact_math.displacement_matrix: B[t,a,i]=u_pred_mm[t,a+1,i]-u_pred_mm[t,0,i]; the source-u reference uses exactly the same formula. Compose load-linear basis with the existing alpha to obtain the current physical3-vector before the solve, or compose fixed-geometry linear gradients consistently.
exact_math.orientation: A=solve(D,B) has indices[j,i]; G[i,j]=partial u_i/partial x_j=A.transpose(-1,-2). epsilon=0.5*(G+G.transpose(-1,-2)). Symmetrization alone can conceal a G transpose error, so an affine full-gradient contract is needed in addition to a strain test.
exact_math.Frobenius_error: e2=(delta_xx^2+delta_yy^2+delta_zz^2)+2*(delta_xy^2+delta_xz^2+delta_yz^2). Tensor off-diagonal strain is half the symmetrized gradient sum; do not use engineering shear values with these same weights.
exact_math.volume: V_t=abs(det(D_t))/6 in mm^3. Require finite positive volumes and full-rank matrices. Existing P1 is a four-corner proxy and uses absolute volume; it does not establish validity of curved quadratic Jacobians.
exact_math.unit_rule: With physical x_mm and u_mm directly, G is dimensionless and requires no extra scale factor. If normalized coordinates/scaled u are used instead, multiply the resulting gradient by common_u_scale_mm/characteristic_length_mm exactly once. FP64 promotion must precede edge/displacement subtraction; do not subtract rounded normalized float32 geometry then cast.
exact_math.uniform_tetrahedra_importance: For T cells, meanV=sum_all V/T, Q independent uniformly sampled cells, w_t=V_t/meanV. mean_sample(w_t*e2_t) is an unbiased estimator of sum_all(V*e2)/sum_all V. Keep meanV fixed from the complete case geometry, not a sampled batch statistic.
exact_math.full_volume_reference_RMS2: R_c2=sum_all(V_t*||epsilon_true_t||F^2)/sum_all V_t, with the same tensor weights and physical units. Lstrain_c=mean_sample(w_t*e2_t)/R_c2. Average the per-case losses equally. R_c2 must be finite positive; do not silently fit a floor or clipping rule.
exact_math.relative_u_loss: If predictions/targets are common-scaled, weight per-case component MSE by common_u_scale_mm^2/Ru_c^2 where Ru_c^2=sum_all_original_nodes||u_mm||2^2/(3*N_c), using the existing declared floor if preserved. Both branches use exactly the same full-training-node denominator and identical12800 query list.
exact_math.parameter_gradient: D/inverse/volume/normalizers are fixed geometry/reference constants; solve(D,B(pred)) and symmetrization are linear in predicted u. Loss backpropagates first-order through node predictions to parameters. No derivative of model output with respect to xyz and no TCNN second derivative is required. pred.to(float64) preserves its autograd path; detaching/reusing an inference u cache would remove the intended supervision.
exact_math.recovered_metric: Historical nodal epsilon_n=sum_incident_t(V_t*epsilon_t)/sum_incident_t V_t, scattered to all10 original IDs; then symmetric-Frobenius nodal relative L2 across all original nodes. Use the same recovery on predicted and reference training/allowed-validation u. This metric is distinct from volume-weighted cell loss and is not a solver stress tensor.

ranked_issues.name: Fixed importance normalization and consistent tensor-energy convention
ranked_issues.risk: Normalizing by the random sample sum(V), using raw V without meanV, or averaging six weighted slots while using a summed-Frobenius reference denominator changes the proposed objective/relative lambda strength. A denominator computed from volume-averaged nodal strain also differs from full cell-volume reference energy.
ranked_issues.required_correction_or_confirmation: Implement mean_Q((V/mean_allV)*sum6(delta_epsilon^2*[1,1,1,2,2,2])) divided by full-cell-volume reference Frobenius RMS2. Keep all constants per train case and serialize their exact definition. If mean6 rather than sum6 is intentionally used, apply the same1/6 factor to the denominator and record it. Do not compute the denominator from nodal-recovered strain or any validation tensor.

ranked_issues.name: Derivative-loss conditioning and native precision are not repaired by FP64 recovery
ranked_issues.risk: Small/ill-conditioned cells amplify nodal noise. Native TCNN computes node outputs in FP16/FP32 master mode; casting those outputs to FP64 stabilizes the solve but cannot recover output precision already lost. Full-volume normalized lambda1 can make the derivative loss dominate u optimization when relative strain error is large. The941% recovered-node diagnostic is not the same cell loss and must not be inserted as a precise balance estimate.
ranked_issues.required_correction_or_confirmation: Keep the requested lambda0/1 fixed rather than start a weight sweep. Record Lu and unweighted Lstrain separately plus finite backward/nonzero decoder and PointNet parameter gradients in the existing implementation acceptance check. Record physical geometry conditioning / native output precision; fail explicitly on singular/nonfinite cases or gradients. Compute subtract/solve in FP64 without detaching. An improvement would support this discrete gradient objective, not prove exact strain fidelity; no gain may reflect conditioning/precision as well as optimization.
ranked_issues.selection_caution: u-only validation selection may not choose the best gradient-quality step. Preserve that policy for the stated test and report strain at the same u-selected and final checkpoints; do not retroactively select a strain-best checkpoint or consult dia/final-test.

ranked_issues.name: The common u-query distribution changes from the historical teacher
ranked_issues.risk: 6400 uniform nodes plus6400 uniformly sampled-cell corner occurrences is a50/50 mixture. The corner half weights corner-node cell incidence and repeats shared corners; midside nodes appear only in the uniform-node half. Thus this pair changes the common u sampling distribution relative to the old pure uniform-node teacher, even though it is correctly matched internally.
ranked_issues.required_correction_or_confirmation: Use exactly the same1600 cell IDs, corner ordering,6400 uniform node IDs, duplicate occurrences, per-case alpha/feature lookup, shared CAD context and u weighting in both branches. Do not deduplicate only one side or replace corner predictions by detached values. Save both node/cell RNG witness and same-model initialization. Name the baseline mixed node/corner u sampling; comparisons to the historical teacher are context, while the new lambda0 versus1 pair isolates added gradient supervision.
ranked_issues.no_unrequested_change: No recommendation to reweight the mixed u distribution, increase samples, change decoder precision/capacity/lr or run another experiment is made; those would alter the locked proposal.

minimal_implementation_acceptance_only: Synthetic constant translation: gradient and strain zero; affine full gradient matches prescribed orientation/units; skew affine rigid rotation: symmetric strain zero. Existing immutable P1 operator already has these geometry-only contracts; the differentiable training path must preserve them.

An existing bounded synthetic forward/backward contract checks finite first-order parameter gradients and that lambda0/1 share identical query/context/initialization while only the extra loss differs. No new data audit or GT scan was performed by this reviewer.

For constant synthetic cell error, the full reference expression and an enumerated-cell mean of V/meanV agree exactly. This is a formula/implementation contract, not a recommendation for another training experiment.
overall_judgment: No mathematical contradiction is found in the locked proposal when the listed formulas and matching conditions are obeyed. It directly tests whether supervised discrete P1 gradient quality can improve under the same new mixed-sampling teacher budget. Its interpretation remains limited to learned displacement/P1 proxy quality; stress exporter semantics, exact quadratic solver tensors, statistical significance and final generalization are not established.
